name: Karijini National Park
reason: DBCA park page, Wikivoyage park page and Pilbara page ('this region's top attraction'), ANW: a flagship national park.

name: Karratha
reason: Wikivoyage city page and ANW Karratha page: the Pilbara's main town and base for Murujuga, Dampier and Millstream.

name: Mount Bruce
reason: DBCA attraction and 9 km Punurrunha summit trail, plus Wikivoyage Karijini listing: WA's second-highest peak with a marked walk.

name: Newman
reason: Town with its own ANW page (Mt Whaleback mine tours, haul truck lookout, Kalgans Pool, base for Karlamilyi) and a Wikivoyage Pilbara listing: a town visitors stop and base in on the Great Northern Highway.

name: Red Dog
reason: Quirky roadside icon: the Red Dog statue at the entrance to Dampier, named by Wikivoyage Karratha and ANW Dampier ('don't miss the memorial to Red Dog'). Short stop, but the COVERAGE quirky-icon rule keeps it.
